title: The specified etale compactification comparison is invertible
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, e:V\to W an etale morphism of arbitrary schemes [def-weil-etale-morphism], and c=(V\xrightarrow j Z\xrightarrow r W) a compactification with j open and r proper [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-proper-morphism]. On ordinary unbounded etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], let S=D(e_{Sigma!}) be exact sum extension [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension, lem-weil-pbc-etale-restriction-injectives]. The specified graph comparison compactificationEtaleComparison:S\to Rr_*Dj_! is a natural isomorphism. No quasi-compactness condition is imposed on j or e.

source.place: Paragraph 3, etale adjunction normalization. The invertibility argument is the existing source theorem isIso_compactificationEtaleComparison, EtaleLowerShriekCompactificationIso.lean:276--311, with its base-change, restriction-cover and isomorphism special-case lemmas.

proof.text: Use the existing source theorem isIso_compactificationEtaleComparison. Its proof reduces by geometric-point conservativity and the specified base-change equation to a separably closed field. There the etale source is covered by sections, each an open immersion. Compatibility with restriction to these opens reduces to an isomorphism e, where the graph-unit and adjunction triangle calculations make the comparison invertible. The restriction cover is conservative by the source cover lemma. All comparison base-change maps are invertible for finite coefficients by proper base change. This proves invertibility componentwise and hence as a natural transformation.
